Breadcrumbs
Leapwork’s
Web building blocks
provide the core capabilities for designing, running, and validating automation flows in
web applications
across desktop browsers and mobile web. They cover the full lifecycle of a browser based journey:
starting a browser session
,
navigating pages
,
interacting with web elements
(clicking, typing, selecting), and
extracting information from the UI
to assert outcomes or reuse values later in the flow.
In addition to standard interactions, the Web blocks also support more advanced scenarios such as handling dynamic behavior and edge cases, including the option to
run JavaScript
when needed to interact with pages that cannot be reliably automated through standard element actions alone.
To learn more and get hands on practice, follow the
Web Automation Training
.
